name: Work Hours
description: A time tracker for a job with weekly hours: Start and Stop a timer (with a note), add or fix entries by hand, and see how far you are into your weekly target (20 h by default), what's left and how much a day that is. A toast before and at the target, overtime shown in red, a reminder when a timer was left running, a timesheet per week you can copy into a spreadsheet, and optional over/under time carried into the next week. No account, nothing leaves the PC.
author: AmineChr54

weeklyHours.label: Hours a week
weeklyHours.hint: Your weekly target. The ring fills up to it, and anything past it shows as overtime.

workdays.label: Workdays
workdays.hint: Used to work out how much a day is left to reach the target.

warnMinutes.label: Warn before the target (minutes)
warnMinutes.hint: A toast this long before you reach your weekly hours while the timer runs. 0 for none.

reminderHours.label: Remind me when a timer runs for (hours)
reminderHours.hint: In case you forgot to stop it. 0 for never.

carryOver.label: Carry over/under time into the next week
carryOver.hint: On: worked 21 h last week, so this week's target is 19 h. Weeks with no time at all (holidays) don't count.

notify.label: Notifications
notify.hint: Toasts before and at the target and for a forgotten timer. Also allow notifications for this widget (it asks on the first Start).
